title: A YouTube comment on 'Yesterday' and Erroll Garner's influence
summary: A commenter hears Garner in Sands's left hand; Sands praises Garner's influence on all jazz piano.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
